sample_detailed_cases.question: What is the monthly revenue trend in 2017?
sample_detailed_cases.pre_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year_month, SUM(order_items.price) AS monthly_revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp), strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY year_month;
sample_detailed_cases.post_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year_month, SUM(order_items.price) AS monthly_revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp), strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp), month ORDER BY year_month;

sample_detailed_cases.question: What is the quarterly revenue breakdown for 2018?
sample_detailed_cases.pre_sql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 2
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END AS quarter,
    SUM(order_items.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
GROUP BY
    strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp),
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 2
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;
sample_detailed_cases.post_sql:
SELECT
            p.product_category_name,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
            ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue
        FROM order_items oi
        JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
        JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
        GROUP BY p.product_category_name
        ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
        LIMIT 10

schema_hallucinated_table.question: What are the top 15 months by average order value?
schema_hallucinated_table.actual_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT
  month,
  ROUND(total_price * 1.0 / order_count, 2) AS average_order_value
FROM monthly
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC
LIMIT 15
schema_hallucinated_table.expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(CAST(SUM(oi.price) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY month ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 15
